title: Can a Normal Person Afford a Ferrari SUV?
description:
A Ferrari Purosangue starts at about four hundred twenty-four thousand dollars. A used one with under eight thousand miles recently failed to meet its reserve at four hundred forty-three thousand, five hundred. A loan for one has been estimated at about thirty-eight sixty a month. So can a normal person afford a Ferrari SUV? This video answers with published numbers, and shows where those numbers stop. We read Cars dot com, Motor1, AOL, Autoevolution, Yahoo's Modern Car Collector, Kelley Blue Book, the Energy Information Administration, the Census Bureau, a Ferrari dealer, and an Italian parts shop. Several of these are estimates, not receipts. We label estimates, and our own arithmetic is always labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
